svg.title: Reconstruction: what the panel shows while the agent is running
svg.desc: A drawn reconstruction, from memory and public documentation, of the running state of AI agent nodes in workflow automation tools. Not a screenshot of any product.
svg.text: RECONSTRUCTION — NOT A SCREENSHOT OF ANY PRODUCT.
Drawn from memory and public documentation. Composite, not any one product. No logo, brand or product asset used.
This is the entire experience for nine seconds.
The model reasons before it emits a token, then calls three tools in sequence. Every one of
those is a discrete, nameable event the runtime already knows about — which tool, which
records, how long. None of it reaches the screen. The output pane stays empty until the run
finishes, and then the whole result appears at once.
The spinner is honest about only one thing: something is happening. It cannot say whether
the run is progressing or hung, whether it is reading the right data, or how much longer.
So the operator cannot make the one decision available during a run: kill it early.
Nine seconds of nothing also sets the expectation for what comes next: a result that arrives
whole, with no seams, reads as a single confident object rather than a chain of steps that
